title: Exact string matching

problem.name: Exact string matching
problem.statement_latex: Given a text $T\in\Sigma^n$ and a pattern $P\in\Sigma^m$, find $i$ such that $T[i..i+m-1]=P$, or report that no such position exists. The alphabet is finite and characters support indexed queries.
